export_evidence: ImportKey (slug 'eapro-global-limited', 755 records, latest 2026-02-13) shows EAPRO GLOBAL LIMITED only as BUYER/importer of electronic components, e.g. "2026-02-13 | WPG SOUTH ASIA PTE. LTD. | EAPRO GLOBAL LIMITED | INFINEON TRANSISTOR IPP075N15N3G | SINGAPORE, CHINA -> DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 85412900 | BOL 7510250". No outbound (India -> foreign) shipment row with date, destination, HS and B/L was visible in the free view; the only export-adjacent hints are buyer-side entries "TO THE ORDER OF BANK OF BARODA ... DUBAI" (383 shipments, shared counterparty list) and "SEVEN HILLS POWER TECHNILOGIES LIMI ... KAMPALA-UGANDA" (4 shipments) which are not attributable to Eapro as shipper. Source counter: page claims 755 total shipments / 13 trading partners; rows actually seen in free view: 5 shipment rows, 5 supplier rows, 2 buyer rows, 5 port rows. Slug variant 'eapro-global-ltd' returned an empty record set (0 rows).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, eapro.in returned an empty body, eaprogroup.com did not resolve, and the search backend (searx) was down for the whole session ("Connection refused"), so no tender or GST page could be located. Domestic supply therefore remains unverified, not confirmed.
note: Rule 5 applied strictly: the 755 customs records found are IMPORT records (Eapro as consignee of Infineon/Arrow/Illinois Capacitor/Rabyte components into Delhi Air Cargo and Patparganj ICD), which evidence real procurement activity but are NOT evidence of export shipments. No export B/L with Eapro as shipper was seen, so export_status is 'declared_only' at best — the company's own site/catalogue claims were not reachable and are not counted as fact. Declared HS 850720 (lead-acid batteries) does not match the observed component-import HS codes (85412900, 85423900, 85322990, 85043100, 85423100); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS to be corrected to the actual traded codes, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). PAN AADCE1852G and state Uttarakhand not independently verified in this session. No traces of outbound supply found in the sources reachable; domestic side is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' because the registries/tender portals were blocked, not because they were checked and empty.
